title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Terms: Payment Window, Activation and Lapse of an Unpaid Purchase
content:
**Clause.** A Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan is active once the full prepayment is received. The prepayment must be received not later than the purchase date plus the plan's payment window days. Window days are calendar days counted from the day after the purchase date, and the last counted day is included. An unpaid purchase lapses after the window and is cancelled; the tenant may also withdraw it before paying.

The number of window days is set for each plan.

## How the clause applies

- **Starting point.** The clock starts from the plan's purchase date as recorded by the company for that plan. The purchase date itself is not counted.
- **Counting.** Day 1 is the calendar day after the purchase date; every calendar day counts, and the last day of the window is the purchase date plus the number of window days.
- **Boundary.** A prepayment received on the last day of the window is in time. A prepayment received on any later day is not.
- **Status.** Between purchase and receipt of the prepayment the plan is in pending payment status. Receipt of the full prepayment within the window makes it active. A purchase still unpaid after the window lapses and is cancelled. Before paying, the tenant may withdraw the purchase, which also cancels it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Plan's window | Purchase date | Days counted | Last day of the window | Full prepayment received | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 days | 10 March | 11, 12, 13 March | 13 March | 13 March | In time; the plan becomes active |
| 3 days | 10 March | 11, 12, 13 March | 13 March | 14 March | Too late; unpaid at the end of the window, the purchase lapses and is cancelled |
| 5 days | 28 March | 29, 30, 31 March, 1, 2 April | 2 April | 2 April | In time; the plan becomes active |
| 5 days | 28 March | 29, 30, 31 March, 1, 2 April | 2 April | 3 April | Too late; the purchase lapses and is cancelled |

## Plan statuses in this clause

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| Pending payment | Active | The full prepayment is received within the window and the term is set |
| Pending payment | Cancelled | The prepayment is not received within the window |
| Pending payment | Cancelled | The tenant withdraws the purchase before paying |
